
  ▲ vercel redeploy [deployment] [options]

  Rebuild and deploy a previous deployment.                                     

  Options:

  -e,  --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  Environment to redeploy to: production,     
                                    preview, or a custom environment (default:  
                                    the original deployment's environment)      
       --no-wait                    Don't wait for the redeploy to finish       


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Rebuild and deploy an existing deployment using id or url

    $ vercel redeploy my-deployment.vercel.app

  - Write Deployment URL to a file

    $ vercel redeploy my-deployment.vercel.app > deployment-url.txt

  - Rebuild and deploy an existing deployment to a specific environment

    $ vercel redeploy my-deployment.vercel.app --environment preview
